description: Use when you have a plain question such as "does CBD help epilepsy", "where does THC act" or "what binds TRPV1": the best first call, one argument. It finds the compounds, conditions and receptors the question names in Greencyclepedia and answers only from those records: the evidence grade, the key findings with PubMed identifiers, the Greencyclepedia pages, a not medical advice line and cite_as (title, url, licence, accessed date). When the question names nothing Greencyclepedia holds, it says so and suggests the closest names and tools. Educational reference, not medical advice. No doses. Example arguments: {"question":"does CBD help epilepsy"}.

question.description: A plain question that names a compound, a condition or a receptor, for example "does CBD help epilepsy".

name: ask_atlas
title: Ask Greencyclepedia a question
